desc:
Developer support for your site or app is a fixed starter round of bug fixes, safe package updates and small improvements from a developer you can message. Ecom Swift LLC triages your list, fixes the most important items first and tests each change before it reaches your live product.

## What is developer support for a site or app?

Developer support is hands-on technical help for a product that already exists. It covers the work between big projects: a checkout bug, a form that stopped sending, a package with a security warning, a page that has become slow. Support here is a starter round with a clear scope. If you later want an ongoing monthly arrangement, we quote that separately.

## Why small problems become big ones

Small technical issues rarely stay small. An outdated package picks up a known vulnerability. An error nobody reads becomes a weekly outage. A backup that was never tested turns out to be empty on the day you need it. Each problem is cheap to fix when found early and expensive when found by a customer.

Many owners have no developer on call. The list of things to fix grows, but no single item feels urgent enough to hire for. A support round clears that backlog in one planned piece of work.

## How steady maintenance affects your business

A product that runs reliably earns trust. Fewer errors mean fewer abandoned sign ups and fewer apologetic emails. Updated dependencies reduce security exposure and keep the project compatible with new tools, so a future feature does not need a risky upgrade first.

Support also reduces cost over time. Fixes made in order of importance prevent emergencies. A short log of what was done and what to do next gives you a planning tool instead of a surprise.

## What a great support round includes

- A triage of your list, sorted by what hurts users and the business most.
- Bug fixes made on a separate branch and tested before merge.
- Dependency updates applied one group at a time, with checks after each.
- A review of the error log to find problems nobody has reported.
- A check that backups exist and that a restore works.
- Fixes for security warnings in packages, where they apply.
- Error monitoring set up so new failures reach you quickly.
- A basic performance check on slow pages.
- A short written log of every change.
- A maintenance checklist your team can follow, and suggested next steps.

## What we do

We begin with a triage conversation or a review of your messages and error reports. We agree the order of work, then fix and test each item, and send you a plain log. The Basic package covers a handful of fixes with a log. Standard adds more fixes, safe package updates, an error log review and a backup and restore check. Premium covers a larger set of fixes or small improvements, resolves package security warnings, sets up error monitoring, adds a performance check and a checklist.

This is not round-the-clock cover. If an emergency happens after the round is finished, you can order another one or ask us about a separate arrangement.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write your list with one issue per line and how to reproduce it.
- Mark the items that cost you money or customers first.
- Share error messages and screenshots exactly as they appear.
- Keep a recent copy of your data before updates.
- Read the log and keep it for your records.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for large new features inside a fix round.
- Updating packages on your live site without testing.
- Deleting error logs before they are reviewed.
- Making manual changes on the server in the middle of a round.
- Waiting for a crisis to ask for help.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner whose developer is gone and whose site has a list of small problems. It suits a company that has not updated its packages in a long time and is worried about doing it alone. It also suits a founder who wants a second pair of hands before a busy season.

## What we need from you

Send your list of issues, the repository as a collaborator and a short description of how the product is hosted. We do not need passwords. Tell us what you can and cannot change on your side. After you order, we send a short checklist and keep you updated until the log is delivered.
